surface_leak: A union bound over n tail events contributes sqrt(log n).
why_negative: E max of n iid standard Gaussians is (1+o(1)) sqrt(2 log n). The union bound gives the right answer; there is nothing to collectivize.

sources.cite: Standard extreme-value asymptotics; E max of n iid standard Gaussians is (1+o(1))sqrt(2 log n), asymptotically tight (both bounds converge)
